mapper.select: SELECT id_admission_procedure AS idAdmissionProcedure, university_code AS universityCode, entrance_fee AS entranceFee, entrance_fee_2 AS entranceFee2, destination_admission_procedure_id AS destinationAdmissionProcedureId, create_user AS createUser, create_time AS createTime, update_user AS updateUser, update_time AS updateTime, del_flg AS delFlg FROM ADMISSION_PROCEDURE

SELECT id_admission_procedure AS idAdmissionProcedure, university_code AS universityCode, entrance_fee AS entranceFee, entrance_fee_2 AS entranceFee2, destination_admission_procedure_id AS destinationAdmissionProcedureId, create_user AS createUser, create_time AS createTime, update_user AS updateUser, update_time AS updateTime, del_flg AS delFlg FROM ADMISSION_PROCEDURE WHERE id_admission_procedure = #{id}
